# Luphonix React Application

## Overview
This is a React-based digital innovation agency website for Luphonix. The application features a modern dark theme, 3D models, animations, and various pages including services, projects, blog, and contact sections.

## Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 18 with Create React App
- **Styling**: CSS with custom themes and animations
- **3D Graphics**: Three.js for 3D model rendering
- **Animation**: GSAP for smooth animations
- **Routing**: React Router for navigation
- **Icons**: React Icons and Tabler Icons

## Recent Changes (September 09, 2025)
- Successfully imported project from GitHub
- Installed all dependencies via npm
- Configured React development server for Replit environment
- Set up workflow on port 5000 with proper host configuration (0.0.0.0)
- Configured deployment for autoscale with build process
- Verified application runs without errors

## Project Structure
- `/src/components/` - Reusable React components
- `/src/pages/` - Page components
- `/src/context/` - React context providers
- `/src/data/` - Mock data
- `/src/utils/` - Utility functions
- `/public/` - Static assets including 3D models (.glb, .fbx files)
- `/attached_assets/` - Additional project assets

## Configuration
- **Development**: Runs on port 5000 with host 0.0.0.0
- **Build**: Uses standard Create React App build process
- **Deployment**: Configured for autoscale deployment with serve

## Key Features
- Multi-theme support (default, cyber-blue, royal-purple, sunset-orange)
- 3D model integration (Ganesha, Krishna, Lord Shiva models)
- Responsive design
- Blog system with admin functionality
- Contact forms
- Animated components and transitions
